clips.title: The story
paras: Above Ratchet, Strahad Farsan teaches warlocks to bind demons. The human warlock lives in a stone tower in the Barrens, beyond the reach of ordinary Alliance and Horde politics. Students of fel magic come from Stormwind, Orgrimmar, and the Undercity to learn from him.

Strahad Farsan keeps to a stone tower on the bluffs above Ratchet. The goblin port's neutral ground lets him practice dangerous summonings away from Alliance magistrates and Horde shamans. His acolytes gather around him as he studies the Twisting Nether, apart from the struggles over territory below.

Strahad learned the danger of demonic binding firsthand. His first attempt to bind a felhunter nearly cost him his life, leaving him cautious and exacting. Despite being human, he has earned the respect of Gakin the Darkbinder in Stormwind and demonic scholars in the Undercity and Orgrimmar. Warlocks of either faction seeking to command felhunters or fiery steeds are sent to his tower.
